PRIVACY

Privacy

Search, comparison and saved models run in your browser.

Browser storage

This website stores only catalogue model identifiers for your shortlist and comparison. You can remove selections in the interface or clear this site’s data from your browser settings. When browser storage is unavailable, selections last for the current page.

Network requests

The site has no accounts, tracking scripts, advertising scripts or external fonts. A static host may keep standard request logs. Search terms submitted from the home page can appear in the URL and host logs. Enter a model name or machine type and keep your serial number private. External source sites apply their own privacy policies.
